stem: 以下哪些属于客户的可疑交易？(选择三项.)

options.A: 一位客户存入了大量连续编号的汇票.
options.B: 一位客户要求提供向当地公司发放的贷款或由当地银行的债务作担保的贷款.
options.C: 一位客户主要通过电汇进行定期的存款和取款.
options.D: 一名客户收到来自不同未知账户的电汇款项,这些款项随即又被电汇给第三方.
options.E: 一位客户每次取款金额都略低于报告限额.

stem_en: Which of the following are suspicious transactions by a customer? (Select Three.)

options_en.A: A customer deposits a large number of consecutively numbered money orders.
options_en.B: A customer requests loans made to local companies or secured by obligations of local banks.
options_en.C: A customer has regular deposits and withdrawals primarily in wire transfers.
options_en.D: A customer receives wire transfers from different unknown accounts which are immediately wired onwards to a third party.
options_en.E: A customer makes withdrawals each time just below the reporting threshold.
